summary: headstart is a Rust build‑tool that emits metadata early to try to speed up compile and check phases. It works as a CLI and can be integrated into Cargo build pipelines, but it does not provide a library or API beyond command‑line usage. It is aimed at Rust developers seeking marginal compile‑time improvements, yet benchmarks show only a 0.8% speed difference compared to cargo. The project is brand new, has minimal community activity, and lacks comprehensive documentation, making it a niche experiment rather than a production-ready solution.
